name: microspat
description: MicroSPAT 3 build scripts: desktop app (Tauri), standalone server, checks. The version lives in Cargo.toml ([workspace.package]).

scripts.build:server: pnpm --dir ui build --sourcemap false && cargo build --release -p microspat-server --features embed-ui
scripts.serve: pnpm --dir ui build --sourcemap false && cargo run --release -p microspat-server --features embed-ui -- --open
scripts.check: cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace && pnpm --dir ui fmt:check && pnpm --dir ui typecheck && pnpm --dir ui lint && pnpm --dir ui test
